description: Risk and approval policy used to classify every planned capability. Classification is deterministic: each rule contributes the distinct terms it matches, the tier with the most distinct matched terms wins, and ties are broken by the higher tier rank. Any hard gate term found in the request or in a capability description forces approval regardless of scoring.

tiers.description: Inspection, auditing or reporting that changes no file state.
tiers.execution_note: No approval required; still record what was inspected.

tiers.description: Edits that a single undo, discard or named-version restore reverses cleanly.
tiers.execution_note: Take a named version checkpoint before bulk application.

tiers.description: Layout, page-setup, theme, slide-order, import or insertion work with wider blast radius.
tiers.execution_note: Checkpoint the file and re-verify representative slides after the change.

tiers.description: Deletion, overwrite, unlink, rollback or retirement that can remove approved work.
tiers.execution_note: Require explicit human approval and preserve the pre-change version.

tiers.description: Content leaving the file boundary: publishing, embedding, emailing, exporting or download handoff.
tiers.execution_note: Require explicit approval, then verify the route as the intended recipient.

tiers.description: Permission, sharing, ownership or collaborator-role changes that alter who can reach the content.
tiers.execution_note: Require explicit approval from the file owner or delegate before applying.

tiers.description: Public exposure, credential or OAuth scope changes, and handling of sensitive or personal content.
tiers.execution_note: Require explicit approval plus a privacy review before any action.
